description: Use this when the user refers to a menu they saved or scanned in ChefBear without giving its link or menuId (for example "the menu I scanned last night" or "my ChefBear menus"), or asks which menus they have saved in ChefBear. Lists the user's saved ChefBear menus, newest first: menuId, name, restaurant type, number of dishes, up to three dish names, when it was saved, whether a public link is on, and a private link to open it. Read-only. Returns no dish details, taste profile, orders or photos; call get_menu with the chosen menuId. Needs the "See a list of your saved menus" permission, which connections approved before it existed or in older ChefBear apps don't have.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from an earlier list_menus result, to see older menus.

limit.description: How many menus to return, newest first. Defaults to 10.

name: list_menus

createdAt.description: When the menu was saved, ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.description: When the menu last changed, ISO 8601 UTC.

title: List saved menus
